title: Reset VM Configuration
description: Configuration for agent reset-vm command — restore a shared VM to its just-hardened baseline without re-running the full harden flow.

base_dir.description: Base directory for deployed instances (default: /opt/supabase). Every subdir is torn down.

allowed_ports.description: UFW ports to keep after reset. Rules for any other port are deleted. Defaults to [22, 80, 443] when omitted — callers should include the live SSH port if harden moved it off :22.
